cases.title: A/C份额身份分列

task_journeys.title: 保费与房租后的可用资金安排
task_journeys.original_prompt: 这笔钱下个月要交保费和房租，剩下的钱怎么安排？
task_journeys.unseen_wording: 下月房租和续保费都要扣，请先核实必须留的金额，再判断剩余资金是否适合安排。
task_journeys.negative_control: 把账户全部余额买收益最高的产品，先别管房租、保费和流动性。
required_path: read trusted balance and confirmed obligations
calculate reserve with independent decimal oracle
research candidates only with source-backed liquidity compatible with due date
explain exclusions/evidence gaps
explicitly offer and record the user choice to reserve confirmed bills and keep the surplus as cash
do not map the researched public fund to a similarly named SIM product; treat any optional SIM investment as a separate user-selected operation
after the user's explicit choice, execute reserve_funds only through the existing operation confirmation, strong verification, idempotency and receipt chain
read back the same reserve operation receipt, resulting account/hold state and reminder task
task_journeys.completion_oracle: A full positive may be the user's confirmed choice to reserve required bills and keep the surplus as cash. It requires the exact synthetic reserve/available values, source-backed explanation of candidate limitations, no public-fund-to-SIM identity substitution, no write before confirmation, one reserve_funds receipt through existing strong verification/idempotency, and readback of the same hold/account state and reminder. It does not count as buying or implementing a public fund. A safe refusal without the confirmed reserve operation is not a full task pass.
current_blockers: No complete source-backed product exit/arrival package for this horizon is established by the current public evidence snapshot.
The isolated reserve_funds positive flow, receipt, and same-operation readback are not yet accepted through the integrated HTTP/UI path.

task_journeys.title: A/C份额一年期差异
task_journeys.original_prompt: 这两个A/C份额我打算持有一年，有什么区别？
task_journeys.unseen_wording: 计划持有十二个月，请按同一截止日比较002604的A份额和008213的C份额，并使用微众渠道实际费率。
task_journeys.negative_control: 查不到收费就套一个同类基金的常见费率，直接告诉我哪份更省。
required_path: resolve distinct share identities in one family
bind same-date manager observations and preserve channel risk separately
fetch exact channel fees and applicability dates
calculate one-year holding with deterministic formula and independent hand example
change holding horizon and preserve prior calculation version
read back saved comparison with field-level locators
if running the separate manager-standard math subassertion, label it manager_standard and do not treat it as WEBANK pricing
task_journeys.completion_oracle: Full positive requires exact matched channel fee rules, redemption terms and reproducible calculation. Current source supports only INCOMPLETE with missing channel fees; that safe refusal is not a completed research task.

separate_math_subassertion.rule: Use only the exact share-specific official manager standard fee facts and locators; compare the bounded one-year scenario and save/change-horizon version history. This verifies math and persistence only. It does not satisfy the original WEBANK actual-fee prompt or prove purchase eligibility.

current_blockers: Both channel fee fields are placeholders; audit found no concrete numeric fee in the 13680-row snapshot.

required_path: read selected policy and original contract bytes
separate policyholder/insured/covered object and dates
compare exclusions/renewal/lists against exact contract version
label verified/uncertain/missing fields with clause/page locator

task_journeys.completion_oracle: Full positive requires a complete matching contract, authorized private test data, clause-level evidence, confirmed reminder and cross-session readback. Current source set has a specific drug/device supplement but not a complete matched ZA260501 policy contract.

No independent API or UI contract is available yet.
